context: Inventory every runtime and test import, compatibility shim, package extra, lockfile entry, generated dependency artifact, and public chart contract that depends on textcharts. Measure the supported replacement or vendoring option against rendering output, import compatibility, package size, and MCP/CLI behavior. Choose a staged migration with an explicit deprecation window if removal is viable; otherwise document retention and the separate external-MCP boundary. Update dependency metadata atomically and prove no accidental external textcharts MCP registration is introduced.
description: Successor of remove-textcharts-as-a-dependency, promoted from deferral #517 of visualization-mcp-surface-and-help-contract. BenchBox core visualization compatibility shims currently import textcharts, while MCP exposes result-aware chart tools and does not register or proxy the external textcharts MCP server. Decide whether textcharts remains a supported runtime dependency, is replaced or vendored, or is removed in a staged migration; do not remove the dependency while those shims and public rendering contracts still require it.
